text: In the measurement-based (one-way) model of Raussendorf and Briegel, computation proceeds entirely by adaptive single-qubit measurements consuming a pre-built, highly entangled resource called a ___ state.
explanation: The one-way computer consumes a cluster (graph) state by adaptive single-qubit measurements, with feed-forward correcting the Pauli byproducts; a 2D cluster state is universal.
